**Returns:**

The wire form of the error.

## Exceptions

`TypeError` when the error's code is not a wire code or its details violate their schema.

## Remarks

Copies `code`<!-- -->, `message`<!-- -->, and `details` only; `cause` and `stack` stay local. A [TransportError](./contracts.transporterror.md) is client-only and a service never sends it, so it is rejected by the parameter type. Should one arrive through a cast anyway, encoding throws a plain `TypeError` (not a macts error, which would itself need encoding) rather than emitting a code no client accepts.
